body.p: The Office Action of June 13, 2024, has been considered. By way of this response,

claims 1, 3, 11, 18, and 20 have been amended, claims 7-8, 15, 22, and 28 have been cancelled without prejudice to their further prosecution, and claims 29-33 have been added. No new matter has been added. All claims are fully supported by the original disclosure. Favorable reconsideration and allowance of this application are respectfully requested.
Applicant Summary of Examiner Interview

The Applicant thanks Examiner Acosta and Examiner McFall for the courtesies extended to Marianne Buckley (Registration No. 68,104) and Michael Van Ryn (Registration No. 81,871)of Hanley, Flight and Zimmerman, LLC, during the telephonic interview conducted on August 1, 2024. During the interview, the parties discussed dependent claims 22 and 25 as filed in the Response filed on May 15, 2024, in view of the 35 U.S.C. § 103 rejections in the present Office Action. Examiner Acosta agreed that the cited references do not support the § 103 rejections of dependent claims 22 and 25. The amendments and remarks submitted herein reflect the substance of the discussion between the parties.
Comments Regarding Claims Invoking 35 U.S.C. § 112(f)
The Office Action indicates that the term "means for disconnecting" in claim 27 is

interpreted under 35 U.S.C. § 112(f). It is the intent of the Applicant that the noted term in claim 27 be interpreted under §112(f). There is no associated rejection. The Applicant respectfully adds that the recited elements may encompass the structures indicated in the specification as well as equivalents thereof. There are no other means elements in the claims.
The Rejections Under 35 U.S.C. § 112(b)

Claims 3 and 20 stand rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 112(b) as allegedly indefinite. The Applicant traverses these rejections. Nevertheless, as shown above, the claims have been amended for enhanced clarity. Withdrawal of the § 112(b) rejections is respectfully requested.
The Rejections Under 35 U.S.C. § 103

Claims 1, 7-11, 15-16, 18-19, 21, and 25-26 stand rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 based on Landers et al. (European Patent No. 3907136), hereinafter "Landers," in view of Rambo et al. (U.S. Patent Application Publication No. 2022/0252011), hereinafter "Rambo," and Moroika (Japanese Patent No. H1172043). Claims 3, 5, and 20 stand rejected under § 103 based on Landers in view of Rambo, Moroika, and Rambo (U.S. Patent Application Publication No. 2022/0243667), hereinafter "Rambo '667." Claim 14 stands rejected under § 103 based on Landers in view of Rambo, Moroika, and Lavoie et al. (European Patent No. 3578464), hereinafter Lavoie. Claim 17 stands rejected under § 103 based on Landers in view of Rambo, Moroika, and Mariotto (European Patent No. 3805107). Claims 22-24 and 27-28 stand rejected under § 103 based on Landers in view of Rambo, Moroika, and Moon et al. (Korean Patent No. 102004227), hereinafter "Moon." The Applicant respectfully traverses all of the reference-based rejections.

In accordance with the agreement reached at the Examiner Interview of August 1, 2024, independent claims 1, 11, and 18 have been amended as presented herein to include the subject matter of dependent claim 22. Thus, claims 1, 11, and 18, and their respective dependent claims are in condition for allowance. Withdrawal of the § 103 rejections of claims 1, 11, 18, and all claims depending therefrom is respectfully requested.

In general, the Office Action makes various statements regarding the claims. Thus, the Applicant will not address such statements at the present time. However, the Applicant expressly reserves the right to challenge such statements in the future should the need arise (e.g., if such statements should become relevant by appearing in a rejection of any current or future claim). Specifically, Applicant is not conceding that the rejection of any claim prior to amendment was proper. No inference should be made that Applicant is disclaiming any subject matter of the present application. Applicant reserves the right to pursue the unamended claims or any other broader or narrower claims supported by the disclosure at a later date, including in one or more continuing applications. Cancellation of any claim herein is without prejudice to reinstatement in this or continuing application.
The Commissioner is hereby authorized to refund any overpayment and charge any

deficiency in the amount paid in connection with this paper (if any) or any additional fees which may be required during the pendency of this application under 37 C.F.R. § 1.16 or § 1.17 to Deposit Account No. 50-2455.

In addition, if a petition for an extension of time under 37 C.F.R. § 1.136(a) is necessary to maintain the pendency of this case and is not otherwise requested in this case, the Applicant requests that the Commissioner consider this paper to be a petition for an extension of time and authorizes the Commissioner to charge the fee as set forth in 37 C.F.R. § 1.17(a) corresponding to the needed extension of time to Deposit Account No. 50-2455.
